title: The 45-minute rule
inline_answer: No measurable progress on a **vector** in ~45 min → rotate to a different vector on the same box. Whole **box** stalled (all vectors dry) → note state, screenshot, move to the next target; come back with fresh eyes. the engagement is lost by tunnelling on one box, not by missing one technique.

triggers: what do i do on a box
title: The box loop (memorize this)
inline_answer: Recon → enumerate services → identify foothold vector → exploit → **shell → stabilize (TTY) → screenshot** → loot creds → **spray new creds everywhere** → privesc enum → escalate → **proof.txt + screenshot** → capture evidence → submit flags. Never skip stabilize/screenshot/spray.

title: Proof requirements (per OffSec)
inline_answer: `local.txt` (user) and `proof.txt` (root/SYSTEM) from their **original path**. One screenshot per flag showing, in a single image: an **interactive shell**, `whoami`, `hostname`, `ip a` / `ipconfig`, and the flag `cat`/`type` from the original location. **Web shells do not count.** Submit every flag to the engagement tracker before time expires.
